ms.report:
Medium Article: https://oraclecharli3.medium.com/project-1200080-milestone-1-proof-of-achievement-charli3-io-dec-26th-2024-01baa25bb9bb
Direct link to project plan: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1zmYm-33HyIJANBR3FckRFyg5i7GUVLbb/view?usp=sharing

Summary
This milestone was completed in Sept 2024, but we were very late submitting a project POA. The development is ahead of schedule, but POA submissions are very late. Expectation to submit milestone 2 and 3 in the next week.
Key Points
・Milestone 1-2 are complete (pending POAs)
・Milestone 3 is almost complete (pending POAs)
・Txpipe is the contracting lab to work alongside Charli3's core development team
・No change requests are needed as we were able to adapt the project plan to navigate risks and get the SOM accepted
・There is a major dependency on Input Output's development of the Cardano integration tooling, the team learned after creating and winning ADA for this proposal that development for that tooling had stopped. A significant part of this milestone involved planning a way around this tooling and some minor changes were made to milestones that reflect our team's way of navigating this risk. Our plan is to create chain agnostic tooling to bridge data from the Substrate oracle to other chains, including mainnet Cardano. A redeemer based approach is the natural choice for Cardano. 
・Milestones 1 is a collaboration between Charli3 and Txpipe
・Milestone 2-3 are being delivered by Txpipe
・Milestone 4-5 is primarily being delivered by Charli3 and may bring Txpipe on to support
・Team size: 1 project manager, 1 technical leader, 2 rust developers for milestones 1-3, for milestone 4 we will reduce the team to 1 rust developer and bring on 2 Cardano developers from Charli3's team
